Thank you for your interest in contributing to Rocky Reviews ("**the Project**"), owned by
Rocky Reviews ("**we**", "**us**"). This Contributor License Agreement ("**Agreement**") sets out
the terms under which you contribute to the Project. It protects you, us and the users of the
software, and it lets us keep offering the Project under an open-source licence (AGPL-3.0)
while also offering it under other licences (for example the commercial licence that applies
to the `ee/` directory and the Rocky Reviews Cloud service).

You accept this Agreement by posting the comment

> I have read the CLA Document and I hereby sign the CLA

on a pull request to a Rocky Reviews repository. You only need to do this once; the signature
is recorded with your GitHub username and the date.

## 1. Definitions

- "**You**" means the individual who submits a Contribution. If you are contributing on behalf
  of your employer or another entity, see Section 6.
- "**Contribution**" means any original work of authorship — source code, documentation,
  designs, test data, configuration or other material — that you intentionally submit to us
  for inclusion in the Project, in any form (pull request, patch, issue attachment, or
  otherwise).
- "**Submit**" means any form of electronic or written communication sent to us or our
  representatives, including through GitHub, excluding communication clearly marked
  "Not a Contribution".

1. We will always make your Contribution available under at least one OSI-approved

## 5. Your representations

You confirm that:

1. You are legally entitled to grant the above licences. You are at least 18 years old or have

2. Each Contribution is your original creation. Where it includes third-party material, you

## 6. Contributing on behalf of an entity

If you contribute on behalf of a company or other legal entity, that entity must authorise you
to accept this Agreement on its behalf, and "You" in this Agreement includes the entity. If the
entity prefers a separate corporate agreement, contact legal@rockyreviews.dev before
contributing.

## 7. No obligation and no warranty

We are not obliged to use or include your Contribution. Unless required by law or agreed in

express or implied, including any warranty of title, non-infringement, merchantability or
fitness for a particular purpose. You are not expected to provide support for your
Contribution.

## 8. AI-assisted contributions

If a Contribution was generated wholly or partly with an AI coding tool, you remain responsible
for it under Section 5: you must have reviewed it, and you confirm you are entitled to license
it as described here. You may note the tool used in the pull request.

## 9. General

This Agreement is governed by the law of the jurisdiction in which Rocky Reviews is
established (to be fixed at legal review, gate H6). If any provision is unenforceable, the
remainder stays in force. This Agreement is the entire agreement about your Contributions and
supersedes earlier understandings about them. It covers all Contributions you make from the
date of your signature onwards, and any earlier Contributions you have already submitted to
